title: phlomis herba-venti var. pungens
intro: Phlomis herba-venti var. pungens, commonly known as Rock Phlomis, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Rock Phlomis are thought to contribute to its potential therapeutic effects and have sparked interest in its use as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
